text:
What image of harsh death, what shadow of hell torments me? What cruel tyrant follows and kills me with vengeful, lawless hand?


What phantom in the fearful night tears my heart from sleep? Who avenges you on me, divine ingrate, beautiful more for my harm than your good?


Who, when with doubtful foot I tread this sand's solitude, fills the desert with my cares?


Who returns my chain's ancient sound to my ears, if it is certain you do not even remember to cause me pain?

translation.title: A Thousand Deceitful Phantoms Surround Him
